_comment: Coastline of Natural Earth 110m land, rasterised to a 76x44 dot grid, edge-traced and packed into braille at 2x4 dots per character. Exactly half the resolution of coastline.json on both axes, at the same 74N/56S crop, for viewports too narrow to draw 76 characters at a legible size (#51). Static: regenerating it needs tools/build_map.py and the Natural Earth download, and the output does not change.
